SHOCK ABSORBER ASSEMBLY
TSB Revision
REAR SUSPENSION
34-21
>>C<< JAM NUT INSTALLATION
1. Temporarily tighten the jam nut.
CAUTION
Do not use an impact wrench to tighten the jam nut, 
otherwise the jam nut will be damaged.
2. Remove special tools MB991237 and MB991239, and then 
tighten the jam nut to 23 ± 2 N⋅m (17 ± 1 ft-lb).
AC001074 AB
23 ± 2 N·m
17 ± 1 ft-lb
